value: Yet the new axe stands in Frostmourne's shadow. It, too, was fed by the souls of fallen foes; it bears the power of saronite and fragments taken from the Frozen Throne. The chain raises a fear it does not settle: whether this weapon can resist the same doom as Frostmourne. No certainty is offered. Its wielder goes forward bearing both a blade and a question.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
